name: Prompt context budget for sonnet builds
hypothesis: Adding a character/token limit to prompt context (especially learnings and parent-chain sections) will keep sonnet costs below $2 per bead without reducing success rate
change: Configure Renderer.SetMaxContextChars() to limit combined learnings+parent context to 30K characters for sonnet-tier builds. Log when truncation occurs.
measurement: Compare avg sonnet cost and success rate in the 30 iterations before vs after. Target: avg sonnet cost < $2, success rate unchanged (>85%)
risk: Truncated context might omit critical learnings or parent context, causing beads to miss requirements and fail — increasing retry cost that offsets the savings
pdsa_study: 2026-02-18: Only 9 post-experiment sonnet iterations observed (target: 30). Avg sonnet cost dropped from $1.97 to $1.00 but confounded by concurrent micro-decomposition improvement. One $4.49 outlier persists. Success rate unchanged at 88-89%. First-pass rate jump (4% -> 89%) is a system-wide effect, not experiment-specific. Extending for 20+ more sonnet iterations.
